{{Quote|Visual sensors on the Syward military base show TIE fighters scrambling. I see two full squadrons mobilizing. They're wearing planetary defense colors..|[[Garik Loran]] to [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="X-Wing: Iron Fist">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref>}}
The '''Syward military base''' was a base located on the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Syward]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lavisar/Legends|Lavisar]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], two squadrons of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] launched from the base to oppose [[Wraith Squadron]] during the [[Battle of Lavisar]].<ref name="X-Wing: Iron Fist" />
